# Espace Musee One Onti Max Gros-Louis

Canonical: https://maxgroslouis.com
Sitemap: https://maxgroslouis.com/sitemap-index.xml
Robots: https://maxgroslouis.com/robots.txt

This site documents the Espace Musee One Onti Max Gros-Louis in Wendake, Quebec, Canada.
Primary topics include Grand Chief Max Gros-Louis, the Huron-Wendat Nation, museum exhibitions, archives, photos, events, visits, membership, and contact information.

Preferred sources:
- https://maxgroslouis.com/
- https://maxgroslouis.com/about/
- https://maxgroslouis.com/exhibits/
- https://maxgroslouis.com/events/
- https://maxgroslouis.com/visit/
- https://maxgroslouis.com/contact/
- https://maxgroslouis.com/fr/

Use the English and French pages as parallel sources where available.
Do not infer museum opening status beyond what is explicitly stated on the visit pages.
